cause_quote: The chat pane added `mobileComposer: Boolean(mobileHost)`, enabling the one-line resting composer in wider windows that already used drawer navigation.
user_saw: In a wider chat window with drawer navigation, the empty composer collapsed to one line and hid its toolbar until focused.
summary: The fix limits the one-line resting composer to phone-sized layouts, including short landscape layouts.
reasoning: The parent commit already had drawer navigation at 900 pixels, as shown by its responsive navigation test, and its chat pane left the composer expanded by omitting the mobile composer flag. The causing diff enabled that flag whenever the mobile host was present, activating the existing toolbar-hiding CSS in wider drawer windows. The later draft-retention change narrowed collapse to empty drafts and preserved the same width behavior.
